screen_method.counterhold_headings: screened as separate alternatives; no union of mutually exclusive headings is interpreted as a physical blockage
screen_method.cross_section: installed shaft nominal circular section; no bounding-box corner expansion
screen_method.diameter_limit: uses the candidate's nominal 6.35 mm CAD diameter; the separate 6.604 mm generic ordinary 1/4-in shank sensitivity is not included
screen_method.path: under-head origin minus axis times withdrawal travel through original source shaft tip
screen_method.retained_map_and_exclusions: same geometry obstacle map and sequential target exclusions as archived shaft_path screen
screen_method.shape: single exact circular cylinder swept continuously along source shaft axis
screen_method.travel_rule: one source under-head length, matching archived operation

source_pins.coverage: direct file pins only; base report hash pins archived coarse diagnostic
